Method of Attack: BootHole vulnerability allowing attackers to compromise OS boot process despite Secure Boot
Use-after-free in rmmod implementation allowing unloading of modules improperly
Out-of-bound write in USB device initialization leading to memory corruption or arbitrary code execution
Stack buffer overflow in command line parsing allowing Secure Boot circumvention
Improper authorization allowing privileged users to remove memory regions when Secure Boot is enabled
Heap out-of-bounds write in option parser allowing buffer overflow
Heap out-of-bound write in menu rendering code due to incorrect length calculation
Impacted Systems: Unix-based operating systems using GRUB boot loader
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in GRUB2 boot loader commands and modules
